title: Irreducible components of a locally Noetherian scheme are locally finite
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth]. The family of irreducible components [def-weil-irreducible-components] of $X$ is locally finite: every point $x\in X$ has an open neighbourhood $U$ such that only finitely many irreducible components of $X$ meet $U$.

source.place: Tag 0052, topology-lemma-Noetherian, applied on affine Noetherian open neighbourhoods; its finite-component conclusion gives local finiteness of the irreducible components of X
